name: Currency, amounts, and rounding
summary: Integer minor units only. Any capability handling money uses this type. Floating point currency anywhere in a generated product is a defect, and the repository layer rejects a float bound to a money column.

owns.name: Money
owns.description: An integer amount in minor units plus a currency. The shared money primitive; only the kernel may define it.

owns.name: Currency
owns.description: ISO 4217 currencies with their minor-unit exponent.

owns.name: ExchangeRate
owns.description: Append-only, because a historical conversion must remain reproducible after a rate changes.

exposes.name: Money
exposes.signature: Money.of(minor: number, currency: string): Money; add, subtract, multiply, compare, format

exposes.name: allocate
exposes.description: Splits an amount without losing or inventing minor units. Remainder distribution is deterministic, which is what makes split payouts and line-item tax reconcile to the cent.

smoke.name: allocation preserves the total
smoke.asserts: for any total and any ratio set, the allocated parts sum exactly to the total

smoke.name: cross-currency arithmetic is rejected
smoke.asserts: adding two Money values of different currencies throws rather than coercing

templates.description: The currency set enabled for this product, from the manifest.
